scripts.prisma:migrate: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const name=process.argv[1] ? process.argv.slice(1).join(' ') : 'auto_update'; const format=spawnSync('npx',['prisma','format'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if (format.status !== 0) process.exit(format.status ?? 1); const generate=spawnSync('npx',['prisma','generate'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if (generate.status !== 0) process.exit(generate.status ?? 1); const migrate=spawnSync('npx',['prisma','migrate','dev','--name',name],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); process.exit(migrate.status ?? 0);"
